$comment: Named install presets — one command installs a bundle of packs, agents, and loops. A profile is an install recipe, not a skill: nothing moves into profiles/, and a skill can belong to any number of profiles. validate.py enforces that every pack, agent, and loop named here exists. Rationale: docs/rfcs/ (RFC to be written). A role pack already brings `core` through `requires` (RFC-0033), so profiles never need to list it beside one.

starter.description: Everything a new team member needs on day one: the dev-team pack plus the review panel its pre-merge review seats.

architect.description: Design-phase setup: the solution-architect pack, the core skills its stage runs (context-graph, council-review), and the ship-a-draft loop.

full.description: The complete catalogue: every pack, every reviewer agent, every loop.
